skill.name: code-reviewer
skill.description: Reviews code for quality, security, performance, maintainability, configuration risk, and production reliability across common languages and delivery workflows.
skill.summary: Structured code review guidance for security, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
skill.author: sickn33

content.user_title: Review Code for Security and Quality
content.value_statement: Complex changes can hide security bugs, reliability issues, and maintainability risks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides security review using OWASP, secrets handling, authentication, authorization, and API risk checks.
Supports quality review for maintainability, complexity, duplication, naming, design patterns, and technical debt.
Covers performance review for database queries, caching, memory use, asynchronous code, and resource limits.
Reviews configuration and infrastructure changes for CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, and production settings.
Structures review feedback by severity, rationale, suggested improvements, and follow-up actions.
limitations: It provides review guidance and cannot guarantee complete vulnerability detection.
It depends on the code, tests, logs, and context supplied by the user.
It does not run tools unless the host agent has tool access and permission.
It may need language-specific experts for unusual frameworks or proprietary systems.

use_cases.title: Review Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Assess a proposed change for bugs, security issues, missing tests, and production risks before merge.

use_cases.title: Assess Security-Sensitive Code
use_cases.description: Review authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets handling, and API behavior for exploitable weaknesses.

use_cases.title: Improve Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Evaluate configuration, observability, migrations, deployment scripts, and rollback plans before a production release.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Change Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a small pull request or patch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for correctness, security, tests, and maintainability. List findings by severity with concise remediation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Security-Focused Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for authentication, authorization, API, or data handling changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code for security issues. Focus on input validation, access control, secrets, injection risks, logging, and unsafe defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Performance and Reliability Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for services, data pipelines, and production paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this implementation for performance and reliability risks. Check database behavior, caching, concurrency, timeouts, retries, and resource limits.

prompt_templates.title: Release Gate Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before merging a high-impact production change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Act as a release gate reviewer. Evaluate security, reliability, migration safety, observability, rollback readiness, tests, and operational impact.

output_examples.input: Review a new login flow before merge.
output: High: Session invalidation is missing after password reset.
Medium: Login failure logs include user identifiers without retention guidance.
Low: Add tests for expired token and repeated failure cases.

output_examples.input: Assess a database migration for production risk.
output: Medium: The migration may lock a large table during peak traffic.
Recommendation: Split the schema change from the backfill and add progress monitoring.
Follow-up: Confirm rollback behavior before deployment.

output_examples.input: Review a service endpoint for performance.
output: Medium: The endpoint performs repeated queries for each returned item.
Recommendation: Batch related lookups and add timing metrics.
Test gap: Add a high-volume request case.

best_practices: Provide the full diff, relevant tests, and expected behavior before review.
Ask for severity-ranked findings with evidence and concrete remediation.
Include deployment context when reviewing migrations, infrastructure, or configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a broad approval without sharing code or requirements.
Do not ignore low-severity maintainability issues that can grow into technical debt.
Do not use review feedback as a replacement for tests or security scanning.

faq.question: What types of code can this skill review?
faq.answer: It can review application code, infrastructure files, CI/CD workflows, tests, migrations, and configuration changes.

faq.question: Does it replace automated scanners?
faq.answer: No. It complements scanners by adding context, prioritization, and manual reasoning about design and business logic.

faq.question: Can it review security-sensitive changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for OWASP risks, access control, secrets handling, injection risks, and API security.

faq.question: What input produces the best review?
faq.answer: Provide the diff, surrounding files, test results, deployment context, and any known constraints.

faq.question: Can it help with performance issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks query patterns, caching, concurrency, memory behavior, timeouts, retries, and scalability risks.

faq.question: Is it suitable for release approval?
faq.answer: It can support release review, but final approval should remain with qualified project owners.
